title.zh: 游戏本地化质量保证专员

vacancy_label: Wholly fictional synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Test English and Chinese game interfaces for linguistic, layout and locale-specific defects.
requirements.zh: 测试英中游戏界面的语言、布局及区域语言相关缺陷。

requirements.en: Write reproducible issue reports and trace verification results across builds.
requirements.zh: 编写可复现的问题报告，并跨构建版本追踪验证结果。

requirements.en: Coordinate terminology questions with translation partners and support new testers.
requirements.zh: 与翻译合作方协调术语问题，并支持新测试人员。

requirements.en: Build automated localization regression suites integrated with continuous integration.
requirements.zh: 构建接入持续集成的自动化本地化回归测试套件。

requirements.en: Preferred: lead console localization certification submissions.
requirements.zh: 优先：牵头主机本地化认证提交。
